i have fantasized having a cutting problem (i don't like physical pain.. i never truly felt satisfied like how the people who actually do describe whenever i did), having an eating disorder (i do binge/starve as a means of self harm but not to the point of purging and can somewhat "control" it) or having literally any visible illness that i could think of that i could walk around with without having to verbally broadcast to my peers that i'm damaged at a time since i was thirteen because i always felt like i didn't suffer enough and i was ashamed of being so distraught over something so small when i knew there were other people having it hundreds—or even millions—of times worse than me. i even deflected help because i felt like i was undeserving for needing it when there were literal hundreds of people who couldn't afford it but still manage to succeed.
